question: Which declared component of the A15 encoding (apartness clauses, fixed-colour clique, or their combination) makes some stop checks slower than A14, and does the new encoding ever change a decided verdict?

hypotheses.H1: Exact expectation: no variant ever returns a decided stop label or n_min that differs from E0's decided result on the same trace (semantics preserved; only cost differs)
hypotheses.H2: Inferred: the GINC15 unknowns are caused by one component; which one is Open (no prediction is made)
hypotheses.H3: Inferred: E3 (full A15) per-call wall is higher than E0 on the paired replay set

variants.E0: A14 per-size CNF (brute/scalesearch14, frozen) with first-visit symmetry clauses
variants.E1: E0 plus apartness clauses x[t] != x[u] for every apart pair; first-visit symmetry clauses kept; no fixed colours
variants.E2: first-visit symmetry clauses replaced by the fixed-colour greedy clique only (x[c_i] = i, position 0 colour 0); apartness clauses only between clique members (implied by the colours)
variants.E3: A15 as frozen (brute/scalesearch15): apartness clauses plus fixed colours
variants.E4: A15_cube as frozen (E3 plus the per-size cube split on capped queries)

design.note: E0, E3 and E4 are the frozen v0.36.0/v0.37.0 code paths, called unchanged; E1 and E2 are configurations of a new audit file brute/encaudit16.py that reuses the frozen clause builders; they are audit variants, not candidate methods, and none is promoted by this study
design.part1_replay: stop-check replays on sealed final traces, no new world data: (a) the 30 sealed study-039 cases A14 decided (scale12, perm12, control) under E0-E4, once each; (b) the 2 GINC15 traces (perm12 10540007, 10540008) under E0-E4, 3 declared repeats each (repeats measure timing variance; they are part of the design, not reruns); (c) the 12 sealed study-040 scale16 final A14 traces under E0-E4, once each. Every replay uses the 9.0 s query cap and the 240 s case budget
design.part2_fresh: active runs of the frozen arms A14, A15, A15_cube (no new arm) on 12 fresh perm12 worlds and 6 fresh controls, K = 128, 240 s case budget, 9.0 s cap, eps 0, to replicate GINC15 on unseen data
design.per_call_logging: every SAT call records variant, size n, phase, wall, cap hit, clause and variable counts

criteria.GAUD_sem: Exact: over every replay and every fresh case, no variant's decided stop label or n_min differs from E0 (replay) or A14 (fresh) on the same trace; unknown is allowed; WRONG 0 for every variant and arm
criteria.GAUD_loc: exactly one of E1, E2 returns unknown on at least 2 of the 3 GINC15 cells in at least 2 of 3 repeats while the other matches E0 in at least 2 of 3; pass names that component; fail (both or neither) leaves the cause Open
criteria.GAUD_time: reported with a gate reading: paired per-trace median call wall ratio E3/E0 over part 1 (a) and (c) (42 traces), seed-bootstrap 95% CI (10000 resamples, random.Random(41)); pass if the CI lower bound > 1 (H3 confirmed)
criteria.GAUD_stab: in part 1 (b), the stop label is identical across the 3 repeats in at least 9 of the 10 (trace, variant) cells
criteria.GPERM16: fresh perm12: on every case A14 decides, A15 and A15_cube give A14's stop label and n_min (fresh GINC15)
criteria.GQB16: max single SAT-call wall <= 10.5 s for every variant and arm; every overrun is listed with its phase
criteria.G_sound: 0 unsound separating words over all arms in study and recount, equal word counts, 0 truth inconsistencies
criteria.G10: every arm ID on every fresh control (6/6 each)
criteria.GS_ref: CNF reference audit of E1 and E2 on the 12 sealed 040 scale16 traces: 0 mismatches against the reference CNF checker, decided > 0, mutations 20/20
criteria.GTI: TEST_SUITE_041 all modules returncode 0 (test_scalesearch15_0370 is frozen and expected to keep failing; it is reported, and GTI counts only the 041 modules, by declaration here, before data)
criteria.G_PROC: ledger events preregistration, build_authorization, seedcheck, source_freeze, run_start, run_end, recount, reference, tests (041) present, in order, non-decreasing times; commit-order file; main sealed
criteria.G_recount: RECOUNT_041 PASS on the sealed results, 0 mismatches

runtime_estimate: Inferred: part 1 is 30x5 + 30 + 12x5 = 240 stop-check replays (most decided in under 1 s; at most about 60 capped at about 9-30 s each), part 2 is 18 cases x 3 arms; about 400-1200 s on 8 workers. If the pre-freeze smoke projection exceeds 1500 s, part 1 (a) drops E1 and E2 (keeping them on (b) and (c)) by a ledgered pre-run deviation before the freeze, never after
what_counts_as_failure: any gated criterion failing, or any WRONG or contradicting decided verdict; failures are published, not tuned
next_if_pass: v0.39.0: keep the identified harmless component, drop the costly one, and re-run the clean 16-state headline of plan 040 on fresh seeds with the repaired encoding plus the cube split
next_if_fail: if GAUD_sem fails, the encoding is unsound and A15/A15_cube are withdrawn from every later study; if GAUD_loc fails with both components slow, the clique and apartness clauses interact and v0.39.0 tests a non-SAT candidate generator (state merging over the apartness graph) with SAT used only to confirm; if GAUD_loc fails with neither slow, the slow-down is timing noise and GAUD_stab decides: unstable labels mean the 9 s cap is too close to the solve time and v0.39.0 pre-registers a cap-sensitivity study; if GPERM16 fails, the GINC15 regression replicates on fresh data; if GQB16 fails, the cap needs a hard per-call bound (separate process or solver interrupt) before any later timing gate
